definitions.explanation: An established practice or guideline that should be followed.
The state of something being decided or settled.

notes:
{決|き}まり is a noun meaning rule or settlement. It comes from the verb ⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧ (to be decided).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {決|き}まり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧ (to follow rules)
- {決|き}まり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (to feel embarrassed/awkward)
- {決|き}まり⟦{文句|もんく}→文句：03636_monku⟧ (set phrase, cliché)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {決|き}まり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: feeling of embarrassment or awkwardness
- Example: ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}して→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧{決|き}まり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}かった→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (I felt embarrassed for being late)

RELATED VERB:
- ⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧ (to be decided)
- ⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧ (to decide)
